scripts.dev: npm run -s check:node && npm run -s i18n:artifacts -- --with next dev
scripts.dev:lan: npm run -s check:node && npm run -s i18n:artifacts -- --with node scripts/dev-lan.mjs
scripts.build: npm run -s check:node && npm run -s i18n:check && npm run -s i18n:artifacts -- --for-build next build
scripts.i18n:check: npm run -s i18n:validate && npm run -s i18n:pseudo:check && npm run -s test:i18n
scripts.types:check: npm run -s check:node && next typegen && tsc --noEmit --incremental false
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run wallets:check && npm run test:wallets && npm run i18n:check && npm run format:check && npm run types:check && npm run build
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run -s test:i18n:production && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ai: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASPA_AI_ENABLED=true npm run build && NEXT_PUBLIC_KASPA_AI_ENABLED=true playwright test e2e/ai-launcher.spec.ts --project=desktop-chromium --project=mobile-chromium
scripts.test:e2e:i18n:pseudo: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASPA_I18N_BUILD_TARGET=preview npm run -s i18n:check && PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_PSEUDO_ONLY=1 playwright test e2e/i18n-pseudo.spec.ts --project=desktop-chromium
scripts.test:e2e:i18n:production-locales: NEXT_PUBLIC_KASPA_I18N_BUILD_TARGET=production npm run -s i18n:check && PLAYWRIGHT_E2E_PRODUCTION_LOCALES_ONLY=1 playwright test e2e/i18n-production-locales.spec.ts --project=desktop-chromium
